raw_retrieval.method: All recipient offsets against frozen raw donor substrings; prices count mismatching observed coordinate halves, not missing halves.
raw_retrieval.scope_note: These are word matches. The whole recipient clause is not copied from an independently received telegram.

editorial_composition: DON joins the observed DO with a compatible N half-fill; historical context was checked afterward.
DORT already has observed DRT and a compatible O half-fill.
HGRU is already fully observed and is not expanded.
The wholly absent internal letter of EINGE?ANGEN is left unassigned in the common layer; G and L are separately priced alternatives.
no_claim: No calibrated probability or exhaustive unique historical phrase claim.
No all-corpus exclusion claim; selected lexical matches only.
